description: The open-source review layer for AI agents. Work done for humans is decided by humans.
name: io.github.gatewerk/mcp

environmentVariables.description: Gatewerk API key (gwk_...). Generate one at your Gatewerk instance under Settings → API Keys.
environmentVariables.name: GATEWERK_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your self-hosted Gatewerk instance (e.g. https://api.gatewerk.com). Defaults to http://localhost:3100.
environmentVariables.name: GATEWERK_URL

environmentVariables.description: Reviewer email used as decision attribution. When set, decisions made through the MCP server are attributed to this reviewer instead of the API key identity.
environmentVariables.name: GATEWERK_REVIEWER

title: Gatewerk
